name: Fireweed Metals Corp.
summary: Fireweed Metals Corp. engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral projects in Canada. The company primarily explores zinc, lead, and silver, as well as gallium and germanium deposits. Its flagship project is the 100% Macpass project covering an area of 949 square kilometers located in Yukon, Canada. The company was formerly known as Fireweed Zinc Ltd. and changed its name to Fireweed Metals Corp. in June 2022. Fireweed Metals Corp. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
